hypothesis: When ETH has gained against BTC over the 30 days ending at the observed 12H close, long altcoin reclaims may have better follow-through; during relative BTC leadership the short side may perform better.
single_variable: On each V1.7 confirmation use the completed ETH/BTC relative 30-day return to admit signals in that direction. Test the inverse gate as a symmetric control. No change to individual signals, native exits or nine cash-funded slots; readmit all eligible signals individually. Positive ratio change permits long in the primary arm, negative short; exact ties skip. Both markets need 61 consecutive complete 12H closing observations.
baseline: ICX/LRC/WAVES-corrected documented 360-name OKX source, including the original CVC gap convention. 1000U, 1.5x per slot, 20% hourly single-name notional cap, real 5bp taker and 2bp maker fees; separate adverse 5bp on each market leg. Previously inspected history, historical funding and capacity omitted.
